title: Daayra: A Gritty Exploration of Justice — Critics Divided on Its Execution
excerpt: The film receives mixed reviews, with strong performances from Kareena Kapoor Khan and Prithviraj Sukumaran.
body:
• Strong performances from Kareena Kapoor Khan and Prithviraj Sukumaran are highlights.
  • The film's exploration of justice and societal issues is relevant but unevenly executed.
  • Critics note a lackluster climax that detracts from the overall experience.

Critics are divided on Daayra, praising the performances of Kareena Kapoor Khan and Prithviraj Sukumaran while noting the film's uneven pacing and climax. Directed by Meghna Gulzar, this Hindi crime thriller delves into the complexities of a rape-and-murder investigation, exploring themes of justice and societal apathy.

The consensus:

20 published critic reviews average 3.0/5, with most ratings falling between 2.5 and 4 stars. The film's exploration of serious themes garners respect, but its execution leaves some critics wanting more.

What's praised:

  • Kareena Kapoor Khan and Prithviraj Sukumaran deliver compelling performances, effectively portraying their characters' moral dilemmas.
  • The film's thematic depth regarding justice and societal issues is noted as relevant and thought-provoking.

What's criticized:

  • Critics point out that the pacing is uneven, particularly in the second half, which detracts from the overall impact.
  • The climax is described as underwhelming, failing to deliver the emotional payoff expected from the buildup.

What this means for you:

Daayra is currently in cinemas and has a runtime of approximately 130 minutes. For the diaspora audience, the film is in Hindi with subtitles available, making it accessible. While the performances are strong, be prepared for a narrative that may not fully satisfy due to its pacing and climax.
